name: World Beast - Nightingale
text: You can Ritual Summon this card with a 'Legacy of the World Beast' Card. If this Ritual Summoned Monster is Destroyed by Opponent card effect. you can target 1 'World Beast' Monster in your GY Special Summon it. Once Per Turn: You can banish a 'World Servant' Monster from your GY then deal damage to your opponent equal to the banished monsters DEF.
